verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              दुर्योधनो महाराज सुदर्शश्चापि ते सुतः। हतशेषौ तदा सङ्ख्ये वाजिमध्ये व्यवस्थितौ॥१॥
ततो दुर्योधनं दृष्ट्वा वाजिमध्ये व्यवस्थितम्। उवाच देवकीपुत्रः कुन्तीपुत्रं धनञ्जयम्॥२॥
शत्रवो हतभूयिष्ठा ज्ञातयः परिपालिताः। गृहीत्वा सञ्जयं चासौ निवृत्तः शिनिपुङ्गवः॥३॥
परिश्रान्तश्च नकुलः सहदेवश्च भारत। योधयित्वा रणे पापान्धार्तराष्ट्रान्सहानुगान्॥४॥
verses.english: Both Nakula and Sahadeva, O Bharata, are worn out having fought with the wretched। Dhartarashtras and their followers.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनमभित्यज्य त्रय एते व्यवस्थिताः। कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च द्रौणिश्चैव महारथः॥५॥
verses.english: Those there, viz., Kripa and Kritavarman and the great car-warrior Ashvatthaman, have left Duryodhana's side and taken up their positions elsewhere.

verses.sanskrit: असौ तिष्ठति पाञ्चाल्यः श्रिया परमया युतः। दुर्योधनबलं हत्वा सह सर्वैः प्रभद्रकैः॥६॥
verses.english: Having killed Duryodhana's soldiers, the beautiful Panchala prince is waiting there in the midst of the Prabhadrakas.

verses.sanskrit: असौ दुर्योधनः पार्थ वाजिमध्ये व्यवस्थितः। छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन प्रेक्षमाणो मुहुर्मुहुः॥७॥
verses.english: There, O Partha, Duryodhana is in the midst of his cavalry, with the umbrella held over his head and looking all around.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिव्यूह्य बलं सर्वं रणमध्ये व्यवस्थितः। एनं हत्वा शितैर्बाणैः कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसि॥८॥
verses.english: Having re-arranged the remnant of his army, he waits in the midst of his forces. Killing this one with your keen arrows you may achieve all your objects.

verses.sanskrit: गजानीकं हतं दृष्ट्वा त्वां च प्राप्तमरिन्दम। यावन्न विद्रवन्त्यते तावज्जहि सुयोधनम्॥९॥
verses.english: As long as these troops do not fly away seeing you in their midst and witnessing also the destruction of their elephant force, do you, O chastiser of foes, try to kill Duryodhana.

verses.sanskrit: यातु कश्चित्तु पाञ्चाल्यं क्षिप्रमागम्यतामिति। परिश्रान्तबलस्तात नैष मुच्येत किल्विषी॥१०॥
verses.english: Let somebody go to the Panchala prince and ask him to come here. The Kaurava troops are all exhausted. O sire, the sinful Duryodhana will never succeed in escaping.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा तव बलं सर्वं सङ्ग्रामे धृतराष्ट्रजः। जितान्पाण्डुसुतान्मत्वा रूपं धारयते महत्॥११॥
verses.english: Having killed a large number your soldiers in battle the son of Dhritarashtra looks highly delighted as if he believes that the Pandavas have been defeated.

verses.sanskrit: निहतं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा पीडितं चापि पाण्डवैः। ध्रुवमेष्यति सङ्ग्रामे वधायैवात्मनो नृपः॥१२॥
verses.english: Seeing his own soldiers assailed and killed by the Pandavas, the Kuru king will certainly come to battle for his own destruction.”—Thus addressed by Krishna, Phalguna said to him:"almost all the sons of Dhritarashtra, O giver of honours, have been killed by. Bhirna. Only these two still survive; they however, O Krishna, shall also be killed today.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः फल्गुनस्तु कृष्णं वचनमब्रवीत। धृतराष्ट्रसुताः सर्वे हता भीमेन माधव॥१३॥
यावेतावास्थितौ कृष्ण तावद्य न भविष्यतः। हतो भीष्मो हतो द्रोणः कर्णो वैकर्तनो हतः॥१४॥
मद्रराजो हतः शल्यो हतः कृष्ण जयद्रथः। हयाः पञ्चशताः शिष्टाः शकुनेः सौबलस्य च॥१५॥
verses.english: Bhishma has been killed, Drona has been killed, Karna has been killed, Shalya, the king of the Madras, has been killed and Jayadratha also, O Krishna, has been killed.

verses.sanskrit: रथानां तु शते शिष्टे द्वे एव तु जनार्दन। दन्तिनां च शतं साग्रं त्रिसाहस्राः पदातयः॥१६॥
verses.english: Only five hundred cavalry constitute the army of Shakuni the son of Subala. Only two hundred still remain, of cars, O Janarddana. Of elephants the only remnant is a hundred and of foot only three thousand.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव त्रिगर्ताधिपतिस्तथा। उलूकः शकुनिश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥१७॥
verses.english: There remain also Ashvatthaman and Kripa and the king of the Trigartas and Uluka and Shakuni and Kritavarman of the Satwata race.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्बलमभूच्छेषं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य माधव। मोक्षो न नूनं कालात्तु विद्युते भुवि कस्यचित्॥१८॥
verses.english: These, O Madhava, are the remnant of Duryodhana's army. Truly no body will escape from death.

verses.sanskrit: तथा विनिहते सैन्ये पश्य दुर्योधनं स्थितम्। अद्याह्ना हि महाराजो हतामित्रो भविष्यति॥१९॥
न हि मे मोक्ष्यते कश्चित्परेषामिह चिन्तये। त्वद्य समरं कृष्ण न हास्यन्ति मदोत्कटाः॥२०॥
verses.english: Although such a great slaughter has taken place. Duryodhana is still alive. Today king Yudhishthira, however, will be shorn of all his foes. None of my enemies will escape me, today.

verses.sanskrit: तान्वै सर्वान्हनिष्यामि यद्यपि स्युर्न मानुषाः। अद्य युद्धे सुसङ्क्रुद्धो दीर्घं राज्ञः प्रमागरम्॥२१॥
verses.english: Even if they be superhuman beings, O Krishna! I shall yet kill all those warriors today if only they do not fly away from the battlefield.

verses.sanskrit: अपनेष्यामि गान्धारं घातयित्वा शितैः शरैः। निकृत्या वै दुराचारो यानि रत्नानि सौबलः॥२२॥
verses.english: Worked up with wrath in today's battle, I shall, by killing the prince of Gandhara with my keen arrows, remove that sleeplessness which the king has suffered from for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: सभायामहरद्द्यूते पुनस्तान्याहराम्यहम्। अद्य ता अपि रोत्स्यन्ति सर्वा नागपुरे स्त्रियः॥२३॥
verses.english: I shall regain all those valuable properties which Subala's wicked son won from us at the gambling match.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा पतींश्च पुत्रांश्च पाण्डवैर्निहतान्युधि। समाप्तमद्य वै कर्म सर्वं कृष्ण भविष्यति॥२४॥
verses.english: Hearing of the destruction of their husbands and sons at the hands of the Pandavas in battle, all the ladies of Hastinapur will cry.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य दुर्योधनो दीप्तां श्रियं प्राणांश्च मोक्ष्यति। नापयाति भयात्कृष्णं सङ्ग्रामाद्यदि चेन्मम॥२५॥
verses.english: Today, O Krishna, our task will be finished. Today Duryodhana shall be divorced from his prosperity and life.

verses.sanskrit: निहतं विद्धि वार्ष्णेय धार्तराष्ट्रं सुबालिशम्। मम ह्येतदशक्तं वै वाजिवृन्दमरिन्दम॥२६॥
verses.english: take the foolish of Dhritarashtra as dead, O Vrishni hero, if, O Krishna, he does not today fly away from the battle,

verses.sanskrit: सोढुं ज्यातलनिर्घोषं याहि यावन्निहन्म्यहम्। एवमुक्तस्तु दाशार्हः पाण्डवेन यशस्विना॥२७॥
verses.english: You may son Those horses cannot bear the twang of my bow and the slaps of my palms. Proceed there, OKrishna, for I will kill them.

verses.sanskrit: अचोदयद्धयान् राजन् दुर्योधनबलं प्रति। तदनीकमभिप्रेक्ष्य त्रयः सज्जा महारथाः॥२८॥
verses.english: Thus accosted by Pandu's son of great mental strength, the Dasarha heroe urged his horses, O king, towards Duryodhana's detachment.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनोऽर्जुनश्चैव सहदेवश्च मारिष। प्रययुः सिंहनादेन दुर्योधनजिघांसया॥२९॥
verses.english: Beholding that force, three great carwarriors prepared themselves for striking it, for Bhimasena and Arjuna and Sahadeva, O sire, in a body, proceeded against it with loud leonine roars in order to kill Duryodhana.

verses.sanskrit: तान्प्रेक्ष्य सहितान्सर्वाञ्जवेनोद्यतकार्मुकान्। सौबलोऽभ्यद्रवद्युद्धे पाण्डवानाततायिनः॥३०॥
सुदर्शनस्तव सुतो भीमसेनं समभ्ययात्। सुशर्मा शकुनिश्चैव युयुधाते किरीटिना॥३१॥
verses.english: Your son Sudarshana rushed against Bhimasena. Susharman and Shakuni met with Kiritin. Your son Duryodhana on horse back proceeded against Sahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: सहदेवं तव सुतो हयपृष्ठगतोऽभ्ययात्। ततो हि यत्नतः क्षिप्रं तव पुत्रो जनाधिप॥३२॥
प्रासेन सहदेवस्य शिरसि प्राहरद्भृशम्। सोपाविशद्रथोपस्थे तव पुत्रेण ताडितः॥३३॥
verses.english: Meanwhile the heroic and brave son of Subala forcibly struck Sahadeva in the head with a lance.

verses.sanskrit: रुधिराप्लुतसर्वाङ्ग आशीविष इव श्वसन्। प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञा सहदेवो विशाम्पते॥३४॥
verses.english: Thus struck by your son, Sahadeva sat down on his car, all his limbs being covered with blood and himself breathing like a snake.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सङ्क्रुद्धः समवाकिरत्। पार्थोऽपि युधि विक्रम्य कुन्तीपुत्रो धनञ्जयः॥३५॥
verses.english: Reigning his consciousness then, O king, Sahadeva, in anger, covered Duryodhana with keen shafts.

verses.sanskrit: शूराणामश्वपृष्ठेभ्यः शिरांसि निचकर्त ह। तदनीकं तदा पार्थो व्यधमद्बहुभिः शरैः॥३६॥
verses.english: Kunti's son Dhananjaya, otherwise called Partha, displaying his prowess, sundered the heads of many brave warriors on horse back.

verses.sanskrit: पातयित्वा हयान् सर्वास्त्रिगर्तानां रथान् ययौ। ततस्ते सहिता भूत्वा त्रिगर्तानां महारथाः॥३७॥
verses.english: Indeed, Partha, with many arrows, destroyed that (cavalry). Having. killed all the horses, he then proceeded against the cars of the Trigartas.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनं वासुदेवं च शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्। सत्यकर्माणमाक्षिप्य क्षुरप्रेण महायशाः॥३८॥
verses.english: Thereat the great car warriors of the Trigartas, in a body, covered Arjuna and Vasudeva with showers of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽस्य स्यन्दनस्येषां चिच्छिदे पाण्डुनन्दनः। शिलाशितेन च विभो क्षुरप्रेण महायशाः॥३९॥
verses.english: Assailing Satyakarman with a razor-headed arrow, the illustrious son of Pandu, sundered his antagonist's car-shafts.

verses.sanskrit: शिरश्चिच्छेद सहसा तप्तकुण्डलभूषणम्। सत्येषुमध चादत्त योधानां मिषतां ततः॥४०॥
verses.english: With another razor-headed arrow, O lord whetted on stone, that illustrious hero, smiling cut off his antagonist's head crown adorned with a golden.

verses.sanskrit: यथा सिंहो वने राजन् मृगं परिबुभुक्षितः। तं निहत्य ततः पार्थः सुशर्माणः त्रिभिः शरैः॥४१॥
verses.english: He next attacked Satyeshu before all the warriors, like hungry lion, O king, in the forest, attacking a deer.

verses.sanskrit: विद्ध्वा तानहनत् सर्वान् रथान् रुक्मविभूषितान्। ततः प्रायात् त्वरन्पार्थो दीर्घकालं सुसंवृतम्॥४२॥
verses.english: Having killed him, Partha struck Susharman with three arrows and then killed all those carwarriors bedecked with golden ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: मुञ्चन् क्रोधविषं तीक्ष्णं प्रस्थलाधिपतिं प्रति। तमर्जुनः पृषत्कानां शतेन भरतर्षभ॥४३॥
verses.english: He then proceeded with great force against Susharman the king of Prasthala, displaying his anger cherished for many long years.

verses.sanskrit: पूरयित्वा ततो वाहान् प्राहरत्तस्य धन्विनः। ततः शरं समादाय यमदण्डोपमं तदा॥४४॥
verses.english: Covering him, first, O foremost of Bharata's race, with a hundred arrows Arjuna then killed all the horses of that bowman,

verses.sanskrit: सुशर्माणं समुद्दिश्य चिक्षेपाशु हसन्निव। स शरः प्रेषितस्तेन क्रोधदीप्तेन धन्विना॥४५॥
verses.english: Fixing then a strong arrow that resembled the rod of Yama, Partha, smiling, quickly shot it at Susharman, aiming it at him.

verses.sanskrit: सुशर्माण समासाद्य बिभेद हृदयं रणे। स गतासुमहाराज पपात धरणीतले॥४६॥
verses.english: Shot by that bowman chaffing with wrath, that arrow reaching Susharman, passed through his heart in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दयन्पाण्डवान् सर्वान् व्यथयंश्चापि तावकान्। शुशर्माणं रणे हत्वा पुत्रानस्य महारथान्॥४७॥
verses.english: O king, Susharman fell down dead on the earth, gladdening all the Pandavas and distressing all your warriors.

verses.sanskrit: सप्त चाष्टौ च त्रिंशच्च सायकैरनयत् क्षमम्। ततोऽस्य निशितैर्बाणैः सर्वान् हत्वा पदानुगान्॥४८॥
verses.english: Having killed Susharman in that battle, Partha then, with his arrow, killed the five and thirty sons of that king, all of whom were great car-warriors.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यगाद्भारती सेनां हतशेषां महारथः। भीमस्तु समरे क्रुद्धः पुत्रं तव जनाधिप॥४९॥
verses.english: Killing next all the followers, of Susharman with his keen arrows, the great car-warrior Arjuna proceeded against the remnant of the Bharata army.

verses.sanskrit: सुदर्शनमदृश्यं तं शरैश्चक्रे हसन्निव। ततोऽस्य प्रहसन् क्रुद्धः शिरः कायादपाहरत्॥५०॥
verses.english: In that battle, filled with rage, O king, Bhima covered Sudarshana with his arrows.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन स हतः प्रापतद्भुवि। तस्मिंस्तु निहते वीर ततस्तस्य पदानुगाः॥५१॥
verses.english: Filled with rage, the son of Pandu, smiling, cut off his antagonist's head with a sharp razorheaded arrow. The prince fell down dead on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: परिववू रणे भीमं किरन्तो विविधाशरान्। ततस्तु निशितैर्बाणैस्तवानीकं वृकोदरः॥५२॥
verses.english: Upon the fall of that (Kuru) hero, his followers encircled Bhima in that battle, making a downpour of whetted arrows.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शः समन्तात्पर्यवाकिरत्। ततः क्षणेन तद्भीमो न्यहनद्भरतर्षभ॥५३॥
तेषु तूत्साद्यमानेषु सेनाध्यक्षा महारथाः। भीमसेनं समासाद्य ततोऽयुद्ध्यन्त भारत॥५४॥
verses.english: Whilst they were being thus slain, many powerful Kaurava warriors, O Bharata, approached Bhima and began to fight with him.

verses.sanskrit: स तान्सर्वाशरैघोरैरवाकिरत पाण्डवः। तथैव तावका राजन्पाण्डवेयान् महारथान्॥५५॥
verses.english: The son of Pandu, O king, enshrouded all of them with his arrows. In the same way your warriors, O king, covered the great carwarriors of the Pandavas with arrows from all sides.

verses.sanskrit: शरवर्षेण महता समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्। व्याकुलं तदभूत्सर्वं पाण्डवानां परैः सह॥५६॥
verses.english: All the warriors then, of both sides thus fighting with one another, became exceedingly agitated.

verses.sanskrit: तावकानां च समरे पाण्डवेयैर्युयुत्सताम्। तत्र योधास्तदा पेतुः परस्परसमाहताः। उभयोः सेनयो राजन्संशोचन्तः स्म बान्धवान्॥५७॥
verses.english: Struck by one another, the warriors of both armies, O king, began to drop down, lamenting for their (deceased) relatives.
